name: wildcard-excluded-inner-invalid
description: A wildcard SAN whose every expansion is inside an excluded subtree must be rejected: *.foo.example.com expands only to names under the excluded foo.example.com.
references: Go name_constraints_test "subdomain excluded constraints preclude inner wildcard names"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
